summary: The community.general profitbricks modules (profitbricks, _datacenter, _nic, _volume, _volume_attachments) are deprecated for removal in 11.0.0.
questions: Are the profitbricks modules being removed?

answer_card.title: profitbricks modules deprecated
answer_card.answer_md: `profitbricks`, `profitbricks_datacenter`, `profitbricks_nic`, `profitbricks_volume` and `profitbricks_volume_attachments` are deprecated and will be removed in community.general 11.0.0.
